name: Henrik
self_text: Hi! I'm Henrik, a non-binary person from Spain in my late 30s who loves reading history. I play Hollow Lantern on console and I'm looking for ranked matches. I use voice chat only and want someone to coach me. I'm available on Saturday afternoon, Sunday morning, or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who coaches me, and it's a deal-breaker unless we overlap on voice chat. I'd strongly prefer that you are into Hollow Lantern, though I won't rule you out over it.
